newsitem.title: USA: Ascent to form co from SpectraVision buy.
newsitem.headline: Ascent to form co from SpectraVision buy.

text.p: Ascent Entertainment Group Inc said Wednesday a federal bankruptcy court for the district of Delaware gave conditional approval to an amended reorganization plan by SpectraVision Inc. The plan includes Ascent's proposed acquisition of SpectraVision, said Ascent spokesman Paul Jacobson.
The company said it expects the acquisition to close by month's end.

Ascent said it would use its acquisition of SpectraVision to form a new company called On Command Corp, which has applied to be publicly traded on NASDAQ. Ascent said it would remain majority shareholder of On Command Corp.

Ascent said Bob Kavner, who has led communications and media consulting businesses including a practice for Creative Artists Agency, has been named the new company's president and chief executive. Ascent said Kavner will seek to enhance On Command's position by introducing products and services for both the hotel industry and emerging private network markets.
